$comment: Entries present in the upstream weapon files that should not appear on the site. Modular parts and masterable:false entries are filtered by rule in scripts/build-index.mjs; this file is only for cases that need a human decision. Keep it short, and give every entry a reason.

exclude.name: Grimoire
exclude.reason: Duplicate display name with /Lotus/Weapons/Tenno/Grimoire/TnGrimoire, which is the player weapon. This entry appears to be the doppelganger variant rather than something a player owns, so it would put a second unobtainable Grimoire in search results.
